svg.title: PortableSatStation conceptual CM5 and auxiliary PCB stack
svg.desc: FIG-04 conceptual board stack: candidate wireless 4 GB RAM 16 GB eMMC CM5 on official CM5 I/O board, two LimeSDR Mini modules on direct USB 3 paths, and a separate custom auxiliary PCB planned for three-axis motion, sensors, audio and safety. Software GPIO contract revision A is frozen in hardware/cm5/interface.json and docs/CM5-PCB.md; AZ min/max are BCM GPIO 4/5 at header pins 7/29, EL 6/7 at 31/26, POL 8/9 at 24/21, and E-stop auxiliary monitor 10 at 19; NC closed healthy LOW, open/fault HIGH. This is not wiring authorization. GPIO arm/enable signals are requests, not hardware permits. Independent external hard-limit, watchdog and DC-rated latching E-stop guard hardware is only a routed digital review (not qualified, fabricated or released); no motor motion is permitted until reviewed and tested. Not a PCB layout, schematic, wiring or fabrication drawing.
svg.text: FIG-04 - CM5 / official I/O / auxiliary PCB stack (concept)
Block-level assembly reference only: not to scale, not a mounting drawing, wiring instruction, or PCB fabrication release.
Fixed-base compute and interface stack
CM5 compute module - candidate SKU
Wireless / 4 GB RAM / 16 GB eMMC; confirm exact orderable SKU
Official Raspberry Pi CM5 I/O board (selected base/carrier)
Two USB 3 paths reserved directly: one LimeSDR Mini per path
Check exact board revision, connector mapping, power, and dual-RX operation
LimeSDR Mini A
USB 3 direct link A (verify)
LimeSDR Mini B
USB 3 direct link B (verify)
USB audio path unresolved - not yet selected or qualified
Qualified powered hub OR documented/configured USB 2 host; verify power and audio
Separate custom auxiliary PCB (planned)
Three-axis motor / sensor / audio / safety interface
Auxiliary PCB
Own schematic, PCB, JLC BOM + CPL release
Mechanical/electrical mating scheme TBD
POL channel driver selection
Watterott TMC5160 v1.5; SPI1; ramp jumper open
EN high = disabled; confirm clock tolerance/revision docs
Auxiliary-board functions
3 motors, 3 encoders, 6 NC limits, watchdog
GNSS / compass / audio interfaces, pins not frozen
No header-row or pin assignment
Do not order/assemble until reviewed PCB release
HOLD: Blocks do not establish board orientation, mount, interconnect, signal integrity, thermal design, or released wiring.
Power: 5 V / 5 A CM5 I/O input budget; separate regulated nominal 12 V motor rail across verified battery bounds.
USB-C power, SDR host/data and provisioning roles are distinct; connector type alone proves neither USB 3 nor PD. No pass measured.
GPIO contract rev A (software map only; source: interface.json + CM5-PCB.md; not a wiring guide):
AZ min/max BCM4/5 = header pins 7/29; EL min/max BCM6/7 = 31/26.
POL min/max BCM8/9 = 24/21; E-stop auxiliary monitor BCM10 = 19. NC: closed healthy LOW; open/fault HIGH.
GPIO arm/expander enables are requests, NOT hardware permits. External hard-limit/watchdog/DC-rated E-stop guard is not designed/released.
Never wire from this diagram or chat; no motor motion until the independent hardware guard is released and tested.
